name: Template: Customer Support
description: Track support tickets from first report through resolution. Each swimlane is a customer account; each card is an open ticket.

swimlanes.name: TechNova Inc
swimlanes.notes: Enterprise tier. SLA: 4-hour response, 24-hour resolution for P1.

swimlanes.name: Apex Retail Group
swimlanes.notes: Mid-market. SLA: 8-hour response. Contact: IT Manager.

swimlanes.name: FinEdge Ltd
swimlanes.notes: Compliance-sensitive. All support comms may be audited. Use formal language.

swimlanes.name: BlueSky Health
swimlanes.notes: HIPAA environment. Do not share PHI in support threads. Escalate data questions to legal.

swimlanes.name: Mosaic Creative
swimlanes.notes: SMB tier. Self-serve. Generally quick to resolve -- low SLA pressure.

swimlanes.name: Global Freight Co
swimlanes.notes: Enterprise tier. 300 seats. Logistics-heavy workflows. SLA: 4-hour response.

swimlanes.name: Pinnacle Finance
swimlanes.notes: Financial services. SOC 2 environment. Audit trail exports are critical.

swimlanes.name: Redwood Agency
swimlanes.notes: SMB creative agency. 25 seats. Fast response expected but no formal SLA.

swimlanes.name: Atlas Logistics BV
swimlanes.notes: EMEA mid-market. 200 seats. GDPR-sensitive. Dutch business hours only.

swimlanes.name: Vertex Media
swimlanes.notes: Growing account. 75 seats approaching 150. High feature request volume.

swimlanes.name: Ironside Manufacturing
swimlanes.notes: Manufacturing. Shop floor workers with limited tech literacy. Extra patience needed.
